model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the values of CoLeG-E, on the vertical axis, for different LLaMA-2 model configurations. The vertical axis is labeled “CoLeG-E (%)” and ranges from 0 to 50, with tick labels at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50. The horizontal axis represents the LLaMA-2 model names LLAMA-2-7B, LLAMA-2-13B, and LLAMA-2-70B, arranged from left to right. There are four bars for each model, representing different conditions: "no SFT", "+ SFT on D₀", "+ SFT on D₀, D₁", and "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂". These conditions are visually distinguished by color, with "no SFT" represented in light blue, "+ SFT on D₀" in yellow, "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" in pink, and "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" in a darker shade of pink. The "no SFT" bar for LLAMA-2-7B has an approximate value of 6, while the "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" bar for LLAMA-2-70B has an approximate value of 27. Across all models, the bars representing "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" are the tallest, while bars representing "no SFT" are consistently the shortest. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation.
